title: Monomial under global sign reversal
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinate indices, and let $x$ be a vector of $n$ signs. Reversing every sign in $x$ multiplies the monomial indexed by $S$ by $(-1)^{|S|}$, where $|S|$ is the number of indices in $S$.
